body:
The remote thumbnail size seems to need a lot of threading. Excluding size from RemoteImageProvider's hashCode / == overrides would be one solution (i.e. new thumbnails load at the target resolution, but existing ones of any resolution are reused).
At the same time, it is probably desirable for a change in tile size to reload thumbnails at the right size (showing the old resolution until the new one loads). I'm not sure if there's a better solution.
